description: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Give it a product name, a short description and a few photo links, and it writes the script, generates the footage, adds a voiceover in any of 16 languages and hands back an MP4 you can post — in portrait, square or landscape, usually in two to five minutes. Ads are made on your own AdKraft account and use its credits; new accounts start with free credits, and you can check the balance or list the ads you have made without leaving the chat.

defaultPrompt: make a 15-second vertical video ad from this product photo
make three ad variations for my product in different tones
how many credits do I have left on AdKraft?
